notes: No official duty rota (dežurstvo) page found for any entity; no animal poison line found (human poison centres not counted); no veterinary chamber directory found (FBiH/RS chambers not located by search). Many practices were not opened on their own site: ministry-table entries rely on the official table only. Not reachable (robots.txt / bot-check): aura.ba, canisfelis.ba, veterinarskastanica.ba (Sarajevo), weta.ba, vetpromet.ba, vetprijedor.ba, petcity.ba, bl-vet.com (blvet.ba worked), veterinarskaambulanta.ba home page (contact page worked). Not covered: Doboj, Prijedor (VMA Doboj), Zvornik, Bijeljina other clinics (Nutritio only on a directory), Trebinje own site, Foča, Goražde, Mostar own sites, RS/Brčko official veterinary offices, Veterinarski zavod pages, University of Sarajevo vet faculty clinic. Gaj-Vet (found in search) is in Serbia and excluded.
